label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): java.util.Random is cryptographically weak for security-sensitive operations; the rememberMeKey sink at L97 derives from nextLong() which is flagged as insecure randomness. Alert 2 (java/xss): User-provided cookie value flows through decode -> doSomething -> bar -> response.getWriter().println() without HTML encoding, creating XSS vulnerability. Both alerts represent genuine security issues.

evidence.note: java.util.Random.nextLong() generates weak randomness for rememberMeKey
User cookie value flows unencoded into response output
